title: Late Veteran's Van Finds a New Home With Another Veteran
excerpt: Joanna Escobedo kept her late brother's van at their childhood home for about a year. Now the van belongs to Luis Villarreal, another veteran, who says it will help his family travel together.
content:
For about a year, Joanna Escobedo kept her late brother's van at their childhood home. Having it there felt like bringing him home, she said. Now the van belongs to Luis Villarreal, another veteran, according to KGNS.

Villarreal said the gift will help his family travel together without renting a vehicle, KGNS reported.

The dark blue Ford conversion van was presented to Villarreal by the Webb County Veterans Association. According to KGNS, Villarreal did not know he was going to receive the van until the keys and the paperwork were complete.

The story was reported by Elena Stoica for KGNS News on November 26, 2026.

Sources: KGNS; Laredo News (KGNS): Late veteran's van finds new home with another veteran, Nov. 26, 2026.
